import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static int MAX_K = 70;
    static int MAX_INDEX = 35;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        int n, m;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int size) {
            this(size, size);
        }

        static Matrix identity(int size) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + mod) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, B.m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < B.m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        sum += this.A[i][k] * B.A[k][j];
                    }
                    res.A[i][j] = sum % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix pow(long k) {
            Matrix res = identity(n);
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        void rotate() {
            int size = A.length;
            Matrix B = new Matrix(size + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + size - 1) % size][(j + size - 1) % size];
                }
                B.A[i][size] = A[(i + size - 1) % size][size];
                B.A[size][i] = A[size][(i + size - 1) % size];
            }
            B.A[size][size] = A[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < A[0].length; j++) {
                    A[i][j] = B.A[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[MAX_INDEX][MAX_K];

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        long copy = N;
        int INDEX = 0;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }

        // Initialize mat[0][0]
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        }

        // Build first row
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(mat[0][i - 1].n, mat[0][i - 1].m);
            for (int r = 0; r < mat[0][i].n; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(mat[0][i - 1].A[r], 0, mat[0][i].A[r], 0, mat[0][i].m);
            }
            mat[0][i].rotate();
        }

        // Build subsequent matrices
        for (int index = 1; index <= INDEX; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = new Matrix(mat[index - 1][0].n, mat[index - 1][0].m);
            for (int r = 0; r < mat[index][0].n; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(mat[index - 1][0].A[r], 0, mat[index][0].A[r], 0, mat[index][0].m);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index][0].multiply(mat[index - 1][i]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = new Matrix(mat[index][i - 1].n, mat[index][i - 1].m);
                for (int r = 0; r < mat[index][i].n; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(mat[index][i - 1].A[r], 0, mat[index][i].A[r], 0, mat[index][i].m);
                }
                mat[index][i].rotate();
            }
        }

        long used = 0;
        Matrix ans = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        ans.A[(int)K][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= INDEX; i++) {
            while (true) {
                long power = beki(K, INDEX - i);
                if (power <= N) {
                    N -= power;
                    ans = mat[INDEX - i][(int)used].multiply(ans);
                    used = (used + 1) % K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            val += ans.A[i][0];
        }
        val %= mod;
        System.out.println(val);
        sc.close();
    }
}
